title: The normalized finite root endpoint of the Cartier class
statement: Fix l,Y,hY, H and its roots identification as in [det-prop-diagonal-tower-limit]. At level n, for an isomorphism t:H(n)≅diagonalFiniteToPadic(l,n)(geoCartierLine(l^(n+1))), FiniteRootNormalization means the same underlying-map HEq as in the finite-cycle clause of IsDiagonalLimit: diagonalForget(t.hom) is roots.hom(n) followed by cartierProRootMap at the positive exponent n+1. This is a real named predicate sharing the existing endpoint types; it changes neither the normalization nor the root map.

lean.statement:
def FiniteRootNormalization
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) (hY : IsUnit (l : Γ(Y, ⊤)))
    (H : DiagonalSystems l (diagonalSurface Y))
    (roots : H ⋙ diagonalForget l (diagonalSurface Y) ≅
      Scheme.proEtaleRootsOfUnityTower (diagonalSurface Y) l (Fact.out : l.Prime))
    (n : ℕ) (t : H.obj (op n) ≅
      (diagonalFiniteToPadic l n (diagonalSurface Y)).obj
        (geoCartierLine (diagonalResidue.{u} l n) (l ^ (n + 1))
          (cartierResidue_cast l (n + 1)) (diagonalSurface Y))) : Prop
